Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated production-source pixel-art sprite for GRIMSPIRE. Reference is the approved concept sheet; retain its subject identity closely, but remove all environment and lighting. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with no ground, no shadow, no glow, no text, no water, no other objects or people. Flat neutral dark stone and iron, maximum 6 flat material values from charcoal #141920 through dark blue-grey #343d49 to muted #59616b. NO white highlights, NO baked rim lighting or directional lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture. Crisp coarse deliberate pixel clusters and broad readable planes, sparse large fractures; preserve strong gothic silhouette. Use few large shapes instead of tiny noise. Entire object visible with clear margins, strict side view camera, facing RIGHT. Draw full lower portion including normally submerged parts. Transparent holes between halo spokes/wings must be truly transparent. Final art will be interpreted at native game size; keep the silhouette robust and details simple.
Subject: the UPPER LEFT fallen saint head from the reference. Full broken stone head lying tilted face upwards to the right, solemn closed eye, cracked brow and nose, strong chin. Broken iron ring halo behind its head, about half a ring and 4 broad spokes. Neutral marble stone with hair/headdress as broad geometric blocks. Intended native height 104 art pixels, width around 135. Include the broken neck/lower cheek below the future waterline. No water. Relatively simple stone face.
